run_curate_eth3d: run the ETH3D dataset curation script to process images and depth maps into JSONL
run_get_image_paths: run get_image_paths to recursively find all image files in a given directory
run_undistort_fisheye: run undistort_fisheye to correct fisheye distortion on an image and depth map using camera params
review_undistort_fisheye: review undistort_fisheye to understand how OpenCV fisheye undistortion and remapping are applied
refactor_get_image_paths: refactor get_image_paths to support additional image file extensions or filtering options
